name: room-planner
description: Room Planner — a client-only, single-file web app. No runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:test && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:offline: npm run build && npm run build:test && playwright test --grep-invert @network
scripts.test:e2e:update: npm run build && npm run build:test && playwright test --update-snapshots
